evals.prompt:
Users say our signup form is confusing and hard to fill out. Improve the UX and accessibility of this form:

<form>
  <label>Username<input type="text"></label>
  <label>Password<input type="password"></label>
  <button>Submit</button>
</form>
evals.expected_output: A revised form with clearer labels, proper input ids, accessible markup, focus styling, and maybe layout improvements

evals.prompt:
Our top navigation looks crowded and doesn't work on mobile. Here's the code:
Home About Blog Shop Contact
Suggest UX/UI improvements and provide updated markup or styles.
evals.expected_output: Recommendations for responsive hamburger or collapsible menu and spacing, with sample code

evals.prompt: The checkout page feels overwhelming. What UX changes can we make to simplify it?
evals.expected_output: High-level advice on hierarchy, progressive disclosure, and clean design, possibly with layout suggestions
